main.description: Logical-delete a karute encrypted record by writing an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.tombstone with tombstoneType='redact'. The ciphertext envelope is left in place (MST is append-only); future reads MUST treat redacted records as absent. Optional sealing destroys the sender's copy of the sym_key (`tombstoneType='sealed'`), making future decrypt impossible even by the sender. Per ADR-2605231603. Common use: data-correction (mis-entered patient), patient-request redaction (post-Phase-1 GDPR-style erasure for non-medical-mandatory fields).

seal.description: If true, sender destroys the sym_key — recipients with cached key-wraps can still decrypt
